audit.why: 54.89% over 1798 games at 7/10. Annie's point-and-click stun answers a champion whose whole pattern is running at her, but Mortal Steel's third-stack dash and Fate Sealed's 1000-range blink make any unstacked moment fatal.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Mounting Sorrow' is invented — it appears in whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid and wants.foe[1] as Yone's level 6 ability, described as a 'knockup-into-execute' with a 'mark execute'. Yone's R is Fate Sealed and it is neither a knockup nor an execute. Spirit Cleave's shield was never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's text: Fate Sealed 'blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him' — a blink and a pull, 120/100/80s, 1000 range. The knockup in his kit belongs to Mortal Steel at two Gathering Storm stacks, not the ultimate. Separately, Spirit Cleave shields him on a 14s cooldown scaling with attack speed, which is the shield that eats Annie's burst window.
audit.corrected: All four fabricated references replaced with Fate Sealed and its real behaviour; Spirit Cleave's 14s shield written into the cooldown and trade advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound was labelled 'matchup-defining' with no number.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s — a 22-second gap at rank 1, the longest reliable window Annie gets in this lane.
audit.corrected: The 22s figure written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] credits Annie with a 'Tibbers' passive armor buffer' at level 3.
audit.why: Annie has no such thing at level 3 — Tibbers is the level 6 ultimate. What she gets at 3 is Molten Shield, which is what actually lets her stack Pyromania safely.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave used the generic 'every assassin timer in the game' template.
audit.why: Yone's specific punish on a shoved wave is stacking Mortal Steel off the minions and dashing the empowered third cast into her.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Molten Shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1 — the spirit repeats its damage on the way back, so survive the window and punish the body it returns to. - Spirit Cleave re-shields him every 14s: force it out before you spend the stun.

edits.before: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: The damage repeats when his spirit returns — survive it, then punish the body across those 22s.

edits.before: Yone spends Soul Unbound early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Yone spends Soul Unbound early — that is a full 22 seconds with no second wind.

edits.before: That is Yone’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave re-shields him every 14s in a long trade.

edits.before: Carry through the one button — Flash-Tibbers on two is a won fight; your whole game is engineering the radius.
edits.after: Carry through one button — Flash-Tibbers once Spirit Cleave is spent; engineering that 14-second gap is the game.

edits.before: Level 6: Mounting Sorrow gives Yone a knockup-into-execute all-in that outpaces your kit for one level, tilting this phase to him.
edits.after: Level 6: Fate Sealed blinks him behind you and drags everything it hits back in, outpacing your kit for a level and tilting the phase to him.

edits.after: Level 3: still roughly a coinflip — Molten Shield lets you stack Pyromania safely, but he unlocks Soul Unbound's delayed return damage, so it stays on execution.

edits.before: Yone's Lvl 6 spike is scarier than yours here — Mounting Sorrow gives him a knock-up/execute combo that punishes you if Tibbers isn't up, so hold summoner spells and ward the roam lanes until your own ult resets the fight in your favor.
edits.after: Yone's Lvl 6 spike is scarier than yours here — Fate Sealed blinks him behind the last target in a line and pulls everyone it hits back to him, so hold summoners and ward the roam lanes until your own ult resets the fight.

edits.before: From level 3 onward you get real teeth: E-Q-W stuns him for a full second, long enough to dump Incinerate and Disintegrate before he can even flash away, and if he ever face-checks your bear ambush at level 4-5 he's dead. His level 6 spike briefly swings it back — Mounting Sorrow's knock-up plus the mark execute lets him blow you up if he catches you without Tibbers, so play it safe the moment he hits 6 until your own ultimate comes online a level later.
edits.after: From level 3 onward you get real teeth: a stocked Pyromania stun buys long enough to dump Incinerate and Disintegrate before he can answer, and if he face-checks you at 4-5 with Spirit Cleave down he is dead. His level 6 spike briefly swings it back — Fate Sealed blinks him past you and drags you back in, so play it safe the moment he hits 6 until your own ultimate comes online a level later.

edits.before: All-in the instant Mounting Sorrow is up before Annie hits her own 6
edits.after: All-in the instant Fate Sealed is up, before Annie reaches her own 6
